desc: deterministic LLM token-count estimate for budgeting
usage: send the text (or {"text":"..."}); returns tokens=~N chars= words= lines= bytes= method=heuristic-v1 (about 1 token per 4 letters, 1 per symbol; within ~15% of BPE tokenizers)
out: tokens=~N chars=N words=N lines=N bytes=N method=heuristic-v1

examples.out: tokens=~6 chars=20 words=4 lines=1 bytes=20 method=heuristic-v1

tests.in_text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
